{{Top|leg}}
'''Long-range spectrometry equipment''' was a technology considered recent as of around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

A team of the [[exploratory branch of Outer Rim Oreworks]] used long-range spectrometry equipment to value the [[Lamaro system]]. They found that the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] had a concentration of useful metals larger than previous estimates had revealed.
